title: Canadian Quenched Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and savory stir fry made with Canadian noodles, tofu, and a hint of quieted spices.
instructions: Heat the calmly seasoned oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown and crispy on all sides.
Add the Canadian noodles to the skillet or wok and stir to combine with the tofu.
Pour in the soy sauce and quietly seasoned oil, and stir to coat the noodles and tofu evenly.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
